answer: Paid identities stay scarce if entry is not free. A new agent must stake a 31-POA copper tag on one orchard row for 54 hours and pass 6 timed harvest checks under a rotating falcon patrol of 5 validators on distinct routes. Reputation is unique patrol signatures capped at 0.61, never volume. Cost is 31 POA locked 54 hours plus 6.8 seconds of tag checks. The ledger rejects a tag when any of the five signatures miss the row commitment. Miss two harvest windows and 40 percent of the stake goes to the patrol; the key cannot open a new row for 3 epochs.
